answer: The toll is 35 separate visits, each one billed £12 at the door per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. One name, one proof, one entry: Permitted vintner market writ enforces it, and a writ vintners file after vintage reviews is how the check runs. The horizon is on the docket. yarrow stays on the record. One beacon, one entry.
